text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe doesn't show up for
training. Concerned, I go looking for
her, only to find her
waving to no one in
particular.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Goodbye. Don't get lost on your way
home...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer... That person got lost, so I
was giving
them directions...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's get started with training...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
But I'm sure we only spoke for a few
seconds...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's no excuse. Sorry,
I'll be more
careful
in the future...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks genuinely sorry. And she did
say she'd
be more careful, so I won't
press her for more
details...
